description: Asks how names resolve when a column, a function and a parameter share a name (columns Date, Len and p of Nm; a declared parameter p over Nm), how bracketed and punctuated aliases, quoted delimiters in both quote styles and a SQL text with an embedded U+0000 are read, what an unknown name and an unknown function return, and how 32-deep and 128-deep nesting of parentheses and of Abs calls evaluate. Each statement is its own snapshot. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
